tips.text: Do the final Railjack confrontation in a full squad; every member rolls a Hound component blueprint per Sister.
Check a new Sister's Hound on her profile before the hunt; a Hec head means that hunt gives you the Hound.
Spawn the Sister solo on normal, not Steel Path, so squadmates cannot steal the Candidate.
Build a Xoris; heavy attacks charge it, and detonating it on the captive Solaris trivializes the Granum Void.
Bring a wide nuke frame such as Uriel or Octavia, or Railjack On-Call specters, if you lack a Xoris.
Waypoint the Golden Hand Tribute first, kill the capture target, then return and offer the crown.
Restart the mission if no Tribute has shown up halfway through the tile.
Kill the Treasurer every cycle for the next crown, then hit Replay on the end screen to re-run.
Expect several hunts; Hec is one of three Models and the blueprint roll is one of twelve parts.
Hold off stabbing a Requiem until you have a clue, and use Oull as a placeholder to test positions.
Check the Model before selling an unclaimed Hound for credits; do not sell a Hec while clearing clutter.
Check the Model before configuring at Legs; a built Hound cannot be taken apart.
Run Conservation and Bounty 1 solo on normal for the standing and bonds.
Players call the Granum Void and Candidate step a slog; with a Xoris a Sister takes about two missions to spawn.
Most players fold this into Tenet weapon farming and keep whichever Hec Hound shows up first.
